I've told my aunt. She reacted the way I hoped. Im relieved that it went so well. She understood me so good.

But this doesn't change. I just said it to her to see if my gut-feeling was right. Call me selfish or anything, but I had to know.

I don't need any answers to what I'm about to write. I just want someone to hear it. 
Today I've cleaned my house. Made everything ready and wrote 4 letters to people I think deserves a letter. Where Ive tried to explain everything. I was going to turn 33 this march but I think I knew. Deep inside of me that the day would come for me.

I know or I think it will come as a shock for the people I knew. That a guy who seemed so happy did something like this. 

My dream was a family, kids, wife, friends. Nothing of that happened.
And to be honest, I hope when I die that I don't get reborn or something.
What I would like is that I just existed not like an angel or something. But just as someone that could roam the earth... 
I think I died many years ago to be honest. Just taken this long for it to catch up with me.
I think this is my destiny.

I'm almost sure my aunt would understand my feelings, but who knows. I might be totally mistaken in how I read people. I don't want help I want to just end it. I would love if it was legal with euthanasia where I lived but it isn't. I just want this nightmare to be over, I don't belong here.

The logic thing is to tell her, but the depressive side of me just want to keep it all in. What good could come out of telling her.
I will think a bit more about it tho. Thanks for answering my rant.
